name: Shark's Fury
desc: You are channeling the spirit of the shark.

name: Shark's Exhaustion
desc: Your muscles feel incredibly heavy as the shark spirit leaves your body.
apply_message: The shark spirit recedes, leaving you exhausted!

name: Dry Skin
desc: Your shark-like skin is starting to dry out.  A quick splash of water would prevent cracking.

name: Parched Scales
desc: Your scales are uncomfortably dry and itchy.  You feel distracted.

name: Cracked Skin
desc: Your skin is cracking painfully from extreme dehydration, hindering your movement.
